phases.name: Data & Infrastructure Pipelines
phases.description: This repository collection represents the core infrastructure and data-related components built as part of the isenbek project ecosystem. It encompasses essential tools for data management, system automation, and application development, reflecting a focus on building robust systems for processing and sharing data. The projects range from foundational CSS files to advanced Python libraries and tooling, showcasing a continuous evolution of the development workflow.

milestones.title: BootstrapXL - CSS File for Screen Size

phases.name: Bradley AI Experimentation
phases.description: This period focused on building a terminal application inspired by 'WarGames' incorporating AI elements, alongside experimentation with large language models and backend infrastructure. The project involved integrating a React frontend, streaming a massive Kimi K3 model, and developing a local backend for trading tools.

phases.name: Early Farm Vertical Harvest
phases.description: This initial development focused on establishing a basic framework for agricultural data analysis, primarily centered around farm vertical harvests. The team utilized tools like `cbintel` to gather and analyze data related to crop yields and potentially other farming metrics. Initial efforts were concentrated on collecting data and running the first harvest.

repos.name: bloomfilter
repos.description: The `bloomfilter` repository is a Python project focused on implementing bloom filters. The commits show an iterative process of development, primarily involving updates and improvements to the `bloom.py` file, along with adding features like compression algorithms, integrity checking, and command-line tools for managing bloom filter creation. Initial work included addressing formatting issues and documenting changes in README files.

repos.name: systemd-ngrok
repos.description: This repository, named systemd-ngrok, provides a way to automatically start ngrok using systemd service definitions. The project includes scripts for installation and uninstallation, along with configuration files, and ensures that services are always restarted upon changes. It addresses an initial typo and prevents issues related to cloning the project folder during installation.

repos.description: Example Streamlit app that you can fork to test out share.streamlit.io

repos.name: pincone-examples
repos.description: The pincone-examples repository contains Jupyter Notebooks designed to demonstrate the use of Pinecone vector databases, primarily for applications like semantic search and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG). The notebooks provide hands-on examples covering various features including agents, chunking, Langchain integration, and serverless RAG implementations. It includes documentation and tutorials to help users get started with Pinecone.

repos.name: saas-myfw
repos.description: This GitHub repository contains boilerplate code for the Next.js SaaS framework, covering initial configuration, dependencies, and build process updates. It includes information about recent commits focusing on feature development, bug fixes, and performance improvements. The focus is on foundational setup and maintaining a well-established codebase.

repos.name: bradley.io
repos.description: The bradley.io repository is a TypeScript project focused on developing a web application, initially centered around a 'WarGames' style terminal with WebSocket integration and a homepage revamp incorporating AI and data engineering elements. The codebase includes features like site navigation, project showcases, and documentation related to the terminal’s design and implementation, alongside ongoing development and maintenance tasks.

repos.name: waste
repos.description: The `waste` repository is a C-based inference engine designed to run the large Kimi K3 language model (2.78 trillion parameters) by streaming weights directly from NVMe storage, overcoming RAM limitations. It’s an embeddable system with cross-platform support and a focus on optimizing I/O performance for this demanding task. The project involves extensive testing, documentation updates, and the development of tools to manage the model's loading and execution.

repos.name: housecalls
repos.description: The `housecalls` repository appears to be the development environment for a project focused on agricultural data analysis and potentially related services, utilizing tools like `cbintel` and various models. It encompasses elements such as Michigan ag world modeling, farm vertical operations (including harvest passes), and a 'kit' designed for replicable processes. The repository shows ongoing attempts to run iterations of a process named ‘AG-MI’ with frequent resubmissions due to failures, alongside work on data structures and API integrations.
